g.text: Per-observation VLM features versus demonstrated-action similarity
One window per held-out episode; fixed reference bank. Action-nearest references use future targets for diagnosis only.
Action similarity measures motor commands, not semantic skill or achieved effect. Left panel displays MSE up to 0.1.
